source.note: 英文逐字稿取自 YouTube 字幕；中文為學習用翻譯。版權屬原作者，僅供個人學習。

title: Tom Holland Shares His Favourite Hobbies

lines.en: Teo: Hi, I'm Teo van den Broeke, editor in chief of Esquire UK.
lines.zh: Teo：嗨，我是 Esquire 英國版總編輯 Teo van den Broeke。

lines.en: Tom: And I'm Tom Holland, and we're going to be talking today about some things that make me feel good.
lines.zh: Tom：我是 Tom Holland，今天我們要聊一些讓我感覺很好的事。

lines.en: Teo: So, Tom, golf. Why golf?
lines.zh: Teo：Tom，高爾夫。為什麼是高爾夫？

lines.en: Tom: I like golf just because it's incredibly humbling.
lines.zh: Tom：我喜歡高爾夫，是因為它非常讓人謙卑。

lines.en: You know, no matter how hard you practice or how often you play, you can still have days where it feels like you have never played before.
lines.zh: 你知道，不管你多努力練習、多常打，還是會有那種感覺像是從來沒打過的日子。

lines.en: And for me, I have a really overactive brain, which I think has served me well as a creative, but sometimes I need things to just help me calm down.
lines.zh: 而我的大腦總是轉個不停，我覺得這對我做創作很有幫助，但有時候我需要一些事情幫我冷靜下來。

lines.en: Teo: Have you ever shot a hole in one?
lines.zh: Teo：你打過一桿進洞嗎？

lines.en: Tom: I have done. I've had two hole in ones, yeah.
lines.zh: Tom：有，我打過兩次一桿進洞。

lines.en: Teo: Really?
lines.zh: Teo：真的嗎？

lines.en: Tom: The first one, unfortunately, I was by myself. So, no one believes me.
lines.zh: Tom：第一次很可惜，我是一個人打的，所以沒人相信我。

lines.en: Which is really unfortunate.
lines.zh: 這真的很可惜。

lines.en: And then the second one, I was actually playing in a match against a scratch golfer.
lines.zh: 第二次，我其實是在和一位零差點的高手比賽。

lines.en: And I went against his judgment on what club to hit. And it went in.
lines.zh: 我沒照他的判斷選球桿，結果就進洞了。

lines.en: Teo: That's quite amazing.
lines.zh: Teo：太厲害了。

lines.en: I mean, people kind of run for their mental health, right? Because it's easy, you can throw on some trainers and go out.
lines.zh: 我是說，大家會為了心理健康去跑步，對吧？因為很容易，穿上運動鞋就能出門。

lines.en: But to play golf for your mental health, you need a, I was going to say a pitch.
lines.zh: 但要為了心理健康打高爾夫，你需要一個……我本來要說球場（pitch）。

lines.en: Of course, you need a course. You need all of the kit and everything.
lines.zh: 當然，你需要一座球場，還需要全套裝備什麼的。

lines.en: How often do you find yourself able to play?
lines.zh: 你多久能打一次？

lines.en: Tom: I try and play as much as I can. If I'm not working and I have nothing to do, I really do play every day.
lines.zh: Tom：我盡量能打就打。如果沒工作又沒事做，我真的每天都打。

lines.en: Teo: Right, that's quite a commitment.
lines.zh: Teo：好，那真的很投入。

lines.en: Tom: I wouldn't say golf is good for my mental health, because I'm quite a hothead.
lines.zh: Tom：我不會說高爾夫對我的心理健康有好處，因為我脾氣滿急的。

lines.en: And I can get quite angry on the golf course.
lines.zh: 我在球場上可能會很生氣。

lines.en: Teo: I'm getting nervous about you showing me now.
lines.zh: Teo：你等一下要教我，我開始緊張了。

lines.en: Tom: Yeah, I can get really angry. But no, I play with my friends.
lines.zh: Tom：對，我可能會超生氣。不過不會啦，我是跟朋友一起打。

lines.en: I have a great group of guys that I've played with for, you know, 10 years plus.
lines.zh: 我有一群很棒的朋友，我們一起打了十幾年。

lines.en: And some of them are much better than me, some of them are sort of the same level as me.
lines.zh: 有些人比我厲害很多，有些人和我程度差不多。

lines.en: And no, I love it. I absolutely love it.
lines.zh: 我很愛打，真的超愛。

lines.en: Teo: Okay, well, let me see what you're working with.
lines.zh: Teo：好，那讓我看看你的本事。

lines.en: Tom: Here we go. It's the 18th hole.
lines.zh: Tom：開始吧，這是第 18 洞。

lines.en: Teo: Right, so am I aiming for a hole in one?
lines.zh: Teo：好，所以我要瞄準一桿進洞嗎？

lines.en: Tom: Last putt to win the Masters, which is next weekend.
lines.zh: Tom：贏得名人賽的最後一推，名人賽就在下週末。

lines.en: Try and close your hips a little bit. There you go. That's a better putt.
lines.zh: 試著把髖部稍微收一點。對，這樣推桿好多了。

lines.en: You see how your club is closed? Let go of it. That's squarer to yourself.
lines.zh: 你看你的桿面是關閉的？放鬆一點，這樣就和你自己比較正了。

lines.en: That should be a better shot.
lines.zh: 這樣應該會打得比較好。

lines.en: Teo: Okay. And then I'm looking at the hole. Am I going to aim up?
lines.zh: Teo：好，然後我要看洞嗎？要瞄準嗎？

lines.en: Tom: Just look at the ball. And don't even look at where it goes.
lines.zh: Tom：只要看著球就好，連球往哪裡去都不用看。

lines.en: Teo: Oh, really? That feels counterintuitive.
lines.zh: Teo：喔，真的嗎？這感覺很違反直覺。

lines.en: Tom: That's better. If you hit it just a little softer, that'll go in.
lines.zh: Tom：好多了。如果再輕一點，就會進了。

lines.en: Teo: Okay, I'm enjoying these tips, though.
lines.zh: Teo：好，不過我很喜歡這些建議。

lines.en: Tom: Look at the ball. Close the face a little bit. Now you've overcompensated.
lines.zh: Tom：看著球，桿面再關一點。現在你修正過頭了。

lines.en: There you go. And a little softer and it'll go in.
lines.zh: 對了，再輕一點就會進了。

lines.en: Teo: Okay. I dread to think about how this stance is looking on camera.
lines.zh: Teo：好。我不敢想像這個姿勢在鏡頭上看起來怎樣。

lines.en: Tom: You look a little bit like you're taking a poo, but you're okay.
lines.zh: Tom：你看起來有點像在蹲廁所，但沒關係。

lines.en: Teo: Three, two, one. Come on, Tom.
lines.zh: Teo：三、二、一。加油啊，Tom。

lines.en: Tom: There we go. Didn't need any teaching.
lines.zh: Tom：進了！根本不用教。

lines.en: That was kind of a perfect ending to the video.
lines.zh: 這簡直是影片最完美的結尾。

lines.en: Teo: What a dream. You need to see me hit it now. I don't want to after you've drained it.
lines.zh: Teo：太夢幻了。你得看我打一次。你都推進了，我不太想打了。

lines.en: Tom: That was great. You were a good listener. You took the direction on really nicely.
lines.zh: Tom：打得很好。你很會聽，指導你都照做得很好。

lines.en: Teo: Oh, I appreciate that.
lines.zh: Teo：喔，謝謝你這麼說。

lines.en: Tom: If I miss all of these, I'm going to get crucified.
lines.zh: Tom：如果我全部都沒進，我會被罵死。

lines.en: Teo: Your follow-through. That was good.
lines.zh: Teo：你的收桿動作，很漂亮。

lines.en: Tom: Yeah, it's just like you kind of want to point at the target.
lines.zh: Tom：對，就是要讓桿子指向目標。

lines.en: So, wherever the club ends up, like if I followed through to here, chances are the ball will go left.
lines.zh: 所以球桿最後停在哪裡，像是如果我收桿到這裡，球很可能就會往左。

lines.en: So you kind of want to always point at the target.
lines.zh: 所以你要一直指向目標。

lines.en: Teo: It looks like Tom and I got the same score.
lines.zh: Teo：看起來 Tom 和我的成績一樣。

lines.en: Tom: Well, I missed that one on purpose.
lines.zh: Tom：嗯，那一球我是故意沒進的。

lines.en: Do you have any tap dancing experience?
lines.zh: 你有跳過踢踏舞嗎？

lines.en: Teo: No.
lines.zh: Teo：沒有。

lines.en: Tom: Okay. Tap dancing is all about being able to transfer your weight from foot to foot.
lines.zh: Tom：好。踢踏舞的重點就是能把重心從一隻腳轉移到另一隻腳。

lines.en: Teo: Like a footballer.
lines.zh: Teo：像足球員那樣。

lines.en: Tom: Like a footballer or a boxer. If you were boxing, you'd want to be able to change your weight.
lines.zh: Tom：像足球員或拳擊手。打拳擊時，你要能轉換重心。

lines.en: So the first thing you're going to do is stamp. And then you're going to pull your toe back. That's the first step.
lines.zh: 所以第一個動作是跺腳，然後把腳尖往後拉。這是第一步。

lines.en: No, no, no. So stamp, pull your toes up. That's it.
lines.zh: 不不不。跺腳，把腳尖抬起來。對了。

lines.en: Teo: Got it.
lines.zh: Teo：懂了。

lines.en: Tom: I'm joking. I'm joking.
lines.zh: Tom：開玩笑的，開玩笑的。

lines.en: Teo: This is hard.
lines.zh: Teo：這好難。

lines.en: Tom: Stamp. God, I sound like one of my teachers already. No. Do it again.
lines.zh: Tom：跺腳。天啊，我聽起來已經像我以前的老師了。不對，再來一次。

lines.en: Stamp, kick, hop, step.
lines.zh: 跺、踢、跳、踏。

lines.en: Teo: You're very patient, Tom.
lines.zh: Teo：Tom，你真有耐心。

lines.en: I think we do this once more and then we stop, because I'm not going to get it.
lines.zh: 我想我們再做一次就好，因為我是學不會的。

lines.en: Tell me about movement. Why is movement important to you?
lines.zh: 聊聊肢體動作吧。為什麼肢體動作對你很重要？

lines.en: Tom: I think because I've always played characters where physicality is a big part of telling that story.
lines.zh: Tom：我想是因為我演的角色，肢體表現一直都是說故事很重要的一部分。

lines.en: When you play Spider-Man and you put a mask on, you don't have your face to be able to convey to the audience what's going on.
lines.zh: 演蜘蛛人戴上面罩時，你沒辦法用臉向觀眾傳達發生了什麼事。

lines.en: So you have to find a way to physically tell that story.
lines.zh: 所以你得找到用身體說故事的方法。

lines.en: And sometimes with Spider-Man, it can be as simple as cocking the head, which usually tells the people that he's confused.
lines.zh: 有時候對蜘蛛人來說，就像歪一下頭這麼簡單，通常就是告訴觀眾他很困惑。

lines.en: You know, surprise is just like lifting your shoulders up a little bit.
lines.zh: 驚訝就像是把肩膀稍微抬起來一點。

lines.en: And doing that now in regular clothes feels really hammy.
lines.zh: 現在穿著一般衣服做這些，感覺很浮誇。

lines.en: But when you do it in the suit, it really translates really well.
lines.zh: 但穿著戰衣做，效果就非常好。

lines.en: Teo: That's it. So it's almost like mime.
lines.zh: Teo：就是這樣。所以幾乎像默劇。

lines.en: Tom: It's a little bit like mime. Yeah.
lines.zh: Tom：有一點像默劇，對。

lines.en: You were saying that I have perfect turnout.
lines.zh: 你剛說我的外開（芭蕾腳位）很完美。

lines.en: Teo: Incredible, to be fair.
lines.zh: Teo：說真的，很厲害。

lines.en: Tom: Thanks. Something I've done right. Can you plié from there?
lines.zh: Tom：謝謝，總算有一件事做對了。你可以從那裡做蹲（plié）嗎？

lines.en: Teo: How do we plié?
lines.zh: Teo：蹲要怎麼做？

lines.en: Tom: A plié is just down. And then if you were going to grand plié, you would go all the way down.
lines.zh: Tom：蹲就是往下。如果要做大蹲，就要一路蹲到底。

lines.en: Teo: All these shorts are going to rip.
lines.zh: Teo：這條短褲會裂開啦。

lines.en: Tom: But you can pick your heels up off the floor with a grand plié. There you go. Yeah, that looks really good.
lines.zh: Tom：做大蹲時腳跟可以離地。對了，這樣看起來很棒。

lines.en: Teo: That's quite Spider-Man.
lines.zh: Teo：這滿有蜘蛛人的樣子。

lines.en: Teo: So, Tom, skin care routines, do you have one?
lines.zh: Teo：Tom，保養程序，你有嗎？

lines.en: Tom: Uh, yes and no. If I'm working, I have an amazing makeup artist who takes fantastic care of my skin.
lines.zh: Tom：呃，算有也算沒有。工作時，我有一位很棒的化妝師把我的皮膚照顧得很好。

lines.en: And if I'm not working, you know, just a nice little splash of water in the morning.
lines.zh: 沒工作的時候，就是早上用水潑一潑臉。

lines.en: And I do moisturize and wear SPF, but that's kind of about it.
lines.zh: 我有擦保濕和防曬，但大概就這樣。

lines.en: Teo: Is there any specific moisturizer you go for?
lines.zh: Teo：你有特別愛用哪一款保濕乳嗎？

lines.en: Tom: Yes, I wouldn't be able to tell you the name of it, though. And I don't buy it.
lines.zh: Tom：有，不過我說不出名字，而且不是我買的。

lines.en: My lady is in charge of buying all of those creams and stuff.
lines.zh: 那些乳霜之類的都是我女朋友負責買的。

lines.en: One of the benefits is that I steal all of her stuff.
lines.zh: 好處之一就是我可以偷用她所有的東西。

lines.en: Teo: I was going to say, so they're not your specific creams that you're using.
lines.zh: Teo：我正要說，所以你用的不是你自己的乳霜。

lines.en: Tom: And they're probably far more expensive than I think they are.
lines.zh: Tom：而且它們大概比我以為的貴很多。

lines.en: You know, I'm probably putting far too much moisturizer on than I should be.
lines.zh: 你知道，我大概擦了比該擦的多太多的保濕乳。

lines.en: Teo: Other than tap and golf, is there anything in your daily routine you do to make sure you can take care of yourself?
lines.zh: Teo：除了踢踏舞和高爾夫，你的日常作息中還有什麼照顧自己的方法嗎？

lines.en: Tom: Probably just daily exercise, to be honest.
lines.zh: Tom：老實說，大概就是每天運動。

lines.en: I've been very bad recently. I've been traveling a lot, so my exercise has taken a hit.
lines.zh: 我最近很糟，一直在出差，所以運動量大受影響。

lines.en: But if I'm at home and I have a good schedule going, I'll exercise every day without fail.
lines.zh: 但如果我在家、作息很規律，我每天一定會運動。

lines.en: Teo: What does that look like?
lines.zh: Teo：都做些什麼？

lines.en: Tom: Depends on what I'm doing.
lines.zh: Tom：看我在做什麼。

lines.en: You know, if I'm making a movie, then I'm probably doing more fitness-based stuff to try and make sure I can keep my energy up throughout the day.
lines.zh: 如果在拍電影，我大概會做比較偏體能的訓練，確保一整天都能維持體力。

lines.en: If I'm prepping for a movie, for a Spider-Man or The Odyssey, it's all about trying to put on as much weight as possible.
lines.zh: 如果是在為電影做準備，像是《蜘蛛人》或《奧德賽》，重點就是盡量增重。

lines.en: So, it kind of varies from day to day, really.
lines.zh: 所以其實每天都不太一樣。

lines.en: Teo: What are the things in your life that help keep you grounded?
lines.zh: Teo：生活中有哪些事情幫助你保持踏實？

lines.en: Tom: Definitely my family and my friends.
lines.zh: Tom：一定是我的家人和朋友。

lines.en: You know, I'm very lucky to have a group of friends that will always be incredibly honest and are not yes-people.
lines.zh: 我很幸運有一群朋友，他們永遠都非常誠實，不是只會說好話的人。

lines.en: That has been something for me that has really, really helped me, especially as my life changed as quickly as it did.
lines.zh: 那真的、真的幫了我很多，尤其是在我的人生變化得那麼快的時候。

lines.en: But yeah, I'd say my friends and my family.
lines.zh: 所以對，我會說是朋友和家人。

lines.en: Teo: If you could go back and give your younger self one piece of advice, what would it be?
lines.zh: Teo：如果能回到過去給年輕的自己一個建議，會是什麼？

lines.en: Tom: To be perfectly honest with you, I am so happy with where I'm at in my life right now. I probably wouldn't change anything.
lines.zh: Tom：老實跟你說，我對現在的人生狀態非常滿意，大概什麼都不會改。

lines.en: You know, I've made mistakes and all that sort of stuff, but I've learned from all of them.
lines.zh: 我犯過錯什麼的，但我從每一個錯誤中都學到了東西。

lines.en: I probably would maybe tell myself to take more holidays as a younger person. Maybe go traveling, actually.
lines.zh: 我大概會告訴年輕的自己多放點假，其實應該去旅行。

lines.en: My cousin is just about to go traveling through Asia, and I really wish when I was 17, 18 that I had done something like that.
lines.zh: 我表弟正要去亞洲旅行，我真希望自己十七、八歲時也做過那樣的事。

lines.en: Like thrown a backpack on and traveled somewhere.
lines.zh: 背起背包，去某個地方旅行。

lines.en: So, maybe that's what I would have told myself.
lines.zh: 所以，也許那就是我會告訴自己的話。

lines.en: Teo: Is there one destination you've not been to that you'd really make a beeline for?
lines.zh: Teo：有沒有哪個還沒去過、很想直奔的地方？

lines.en: Tom: I mean, I've been to Japan a bunch of times for work, but never for pleasure, and I would love to go and explore Japan.
lines.zh: Tom：我去過日本好多次，都是工作，從來沒去玩過，我很想去好好探索日本。

lines.en: Teo: Quick-fire round. Morning cleanse or water rinse?
lines.zh: Teo：快問快答。早上用洗面乳還是清水洗臉？

lines.en: Tom: Water rinse.
lines.zh: Tom：清水洗臉。

lines.en: Teo: Same daily routine or switch it up?
lines.zh: Teo：每天固定作息，還是常常變換？

lines.en: Tom: I probably would have to say switch it up, only because I'm terrible at keeping to a routine.
lines.zh: Tom：我大概得說常常變換，只因為我很不會維持固定作息。

lines.en: Teo: SPF only on sunny days or every single day?
lines.zh: Teo：防曬只在晴天擦，還是每天都擦？

lines.en: Tom: Every day SPF.
lines.zh: Tom：每天都擦防曬。

lines.en: Teo: That sounds like a self-care routine to me.
lines.zh: Teo：這在我聽來就是一套自我照顧的程序了。

lines.en: Tom: Yeah, but that's very simple. That's like moisturizer and sun cream rolled into one, you know.
lines.zh: Tom：對，但很簡單。就是保濕乳和防曬乳二合一，你知道的。

lines.en: Teo: Got it. Serum or moisturizer?
lines.zh: Teo：了解。精華液還是保濕乳？

lines.en: Tom: I don't know the difference.
lines.zh: Tom：我分不出差別。

lines.en: Teo: Lifting weights or cardio?
lines.zh: Teo：重訓還是有氧？

lines.en: Tom: I prefer to lift weights, but cardio is better for you.
lines.zh: Tom：我比較喜歡重訓，但有氧對身體比較好。

lines.en: Teo: Early bird or night owl?
lines.zh: Teo：早起型還是夜貓子？

lines.en: Tom: I would say I'm more of a night owl.
lines.zh: Tom：我會說比較偏夜貓子。

lines.en: I am pretty good at getting up at a good time, but I would much rather stay in bed.
lines.zh: 我滿能準時起床的，但我寧願賴在床上。

lines.en: Teo: What's the average bedtime?
lines.zh: Teo：平常幾點睡？

lines.en: Tom: Average bedtime? Be about 11. Maybe.
lines.zh: Tom：平常幾點睡？大概十一點吧，也許。

lines.en: Teo: Average wake-up time?
lines.zh: Teo：平常幾點起？
Tom：七點。

lines.en: Teo: That's pretty good.
lines.zh: Teo：滿好的。

lines.en: Tom: I'm quite strict to that.
lines.zh: Tom：這點我滿嚴格遵守的。

lines.en: Teo: Yoga or run?
lines.zh: Teo：瑜伽還是跑步？

lines.en: Tom: Yoga.
lines.zh: Tom：瑜伽。

lines.en: Teo: Chicken salad or Big Mac?
lines.zh: Teo：雞肉沙拉還是大麥克？

lines.en: Tom: I actually don't like Big Mac. That's not what I order from McDonald's. I would rather a salad.
lines.zh: Tom：我其實不喜歡大麥克，在麥當勞我不會點那個。我寧願吃沙拉。

lines.en: Teo: Hot or cold shower?
lines.zh: Teo：熱水澡還是冷水澡？

lines.en: Tom: Hot shower.
lines.zh: Tom：熱水澡。

lines.en: Teo: Sauna or steam?
lines.zh: Teo：烤箱還是蒸氣室？

lines.en: Tom: Sauna.
lines.zh: Tom：烤箱。

lines.en: Teo: Wimbledon or World Cup?
lines.zh: Teo：溫布頓還是世界盃？

lines.en: Tom: What? Like, would I like to win either of them? I mean, it'd have to be the World Cup.
lines.zh: Tom：什麼？是說我想贏哪一個嗎？那一定是世界盃。

lines.en: Teo: Really?
lines.zh: Teo：真的嗎？

lines.en: Tom: Yeah, because, you know, to play as a team would be really special.
lines.zh: Tom：對，因為能以團隊一起比賽會非常特別。

lines.en: But Wimbledon is so special, and maybe one of the greatest sporting events of all time. But then so is the World Cup.
lines.zh: 不過溫布頓也很特別，也許是史上最偉大的運動賽事之一，但世界盃也是。

lines.en: I'd have to say, especially because the World Cup is this year, I'm going to put it out there and say the World Cup.
lines.zh: 我得說，尤其世界盃就在今年，我就大聲說出來：世界盃。

lines.en: Teo: Thank you, Tom.
lines.zh: Teo：謝謝你，Tom。

lines.en: Tom: Thank you.
lines.zh: Tom：謝謝。
